teks.id: Pasien naik fase karena lulus tes fungsi, bukan karena “sudah 6 bulan”. Waktu tetap penting sebagai batas bawah, bukan izin otomatis.
teks.en: Patients progress to the next phase because they pass functional tests, not because “it has been 6 months”. Time still matters as a minimum threshold, not as automatic clearance.
teks.zh: 患者进入下一阶段是因为通过了功能测试，而不是因为“已经6个月了”。时间仍然重要，但它是下限，而非自动放行。
teks.uz: Bemor keyingi bosqichga “6 oy boʻldi” deb emas, funksional testlardan oʻtgani uchun oʻtadi. Vaqt baribir muhim, lekin u quyi chegara, avtomatik ruxsat emas.

judul.en: Anatomy of the Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL)

pesan.en: The ACL = the knee's seat belt

keterangan.id: Lutut kanan, tampak depan, posisi fleksi (patela diangkat). Ilustrasi skematik, bukan skala sebenarnya.
keterangan.en: Right knee, anterior view, in flexion (patella lifted). Schematic illustration, not to scale.
keterangan.zh: 右膝，前面观，屈曲位（髌骨掀起）。示意图，非实际比例。
keterangan.uz: Oʻng tizza, old tomondan koʻrinish, bukilgan holatda (tizza qopqogʻi koʻtarilgan). Sxematik tasvir, haqiqiy oʻlchamda emas.

judul.uz: Oʻrtacha uzunligi 32 mm (22–41 mm); eni 7–12 mm

judul.uz: Femur lateral kondilining orqa qismi ichki yuzasi

judul.uz: Tibia medial qirrasining old-lateral tomonidagi chuqurcha; boshlanishidan kengroq va mustahkamroq

judul.en: Anatomy of the Medial and Lateral Menisci
judul.zh: 内侧与外侧半月板解剖

pesan.en: The meniscus = the knee's shock absorber
pesan.zh: 半月板＝膝关节的减震器

keterangan.id: Lutut kanan, tampak atas: meniskus medial berbentuk C, meniskus lateral hampir O; zona merah (vaskular), merah-putih, dan putih (avaskular); root/akar meniskus; jejak ACL dan PCL.
keterangan.en: Right knee, superior view: C-shaped medial meniscus, nearly O-shaped lateral meniscus; red (vascular), red-white and white (avascular) zones; meniscal roots; ACL and PCL footprints.
keterangan.zh: 右膝，上面观：内侧半月板呈C形，外侧半月板近O形；红区（有血管）、红-白区和白区（无血管）；半月板根部；ACL与PCL止点。
keterangan.uz: Oʻng tizza, yuqoridan koʻrinish: medial menisk C shaklida, lateral menisk deyarli O shaklida; qizil (tomirli), qizil-oq va oq (tomirsiz) zonalar; menisk ildizlari; ACL va PCL izlari.

teks.id: Menutup ± 60% permukaan kompartemen medial. Menyatu dengan kapsul sendi sehingga kurang mobil; kornu posterior lebih lebar.
teks.en: Covers about 60% of the medial compartment surface. Blends with the joint capsule, so it is less mobile; the posterior horn is wider.
teks.zh: 覆盖内侧间室约60%的关节面。与关节囊紧密相连，活动度较小；后角较宽。
teks.uz: Medial boʻlim yuzasining taxminan 60% ini qoplaydi. Boʻgʻim kapsulasi bilan qoʻshilib ketgan, shuning uchun kam harakatchan; orqa shoxi kengroq.

teks.id: Menutup ± 80% permukaan kompartemen lateral. Lebih mobil; terhubung ke tendon popliteus.
teks.en: Covers about 80% of the lateral compartment surface. More mobile; connected to the popliteus tendon.
teks.zh: 覆盖外侧间室约80%的关节面。活动度较大；与腘肌腱相连。
teks.uz: Lateral boʻlim yuzasining taxminan 80% ini qoplaydi. Harakatchanroq; popliteus payiga bogʻlangan.

judul.zh: 环形纤维 + 放射状纤维

teks.id: Serat sirkumferensial di lapisan dalam, diikat oleh serat radial (“tie fibres”).
teks.en: Circumferential fibres in the deep layer, bound together by radial “tie fibres”.
teks.zh: 深层为环形纤维，由放射状“系带纤维”（tie fibres）相互连接。
teks.uz: Ichki qavatdagi aylana tolalar radial “tie fibres” tolalar bilan bogʻlangan.

teks.id: Hanya 10–30% perifer (medial) dan 10–25% (lateral). Sisanya bergantung pada difusi cairan sendi, sehingga robekan di zona putih sulit sembuh.
teks.en: Only the peripheral 10–30% (medial) and 10–25% (lateral). The rest depends on diffusion from synovial fluid, so tears in the white zone heal poorly.
teks.zh: 仅外周10–30%（内侧）和10–25%（外侧）有血供。其余部分依赖关节液弥散营养，因此白区撕裂难以愈合。
teks.uz: Faqat periferik 10–30% (medial) va 10–25% (lateral) qismi. Qolgan qismi boʻgʻim suyuqligidan diffuziyaga bogʻliq, shuning uchun oq zonadagi yirtiqlar qiyin bitadi.

judul.id: Apa yang Dikerjakan ACL dan Meniskus
judul.en: What the ACL and Meniscus Do
judul.zh: 前交叉韧带与半月板的作用
judul.uz: ACL va menisk nima vazifani bajaradi

butir.id: Menahan 82–89% beban anterior tibia pada fleksi 30°, dan 74–85% pada fleksi 90°
butir.en: Resists 82–89% of anterior tibial load at 30° of flexion, and 74–85% at 90° of flexion
butir.zh: 屈膝30°时承担82–89%的胫骨前向负荷，屈膝90°时承担74–85%
butir.uz: 30° bukilishda tibiaga oldinga yoʻnalgan yukning 82–89% ini, 90° bukilishda 74–85% ini ushlab turadi

butir.id: Penahan sekunder rotasi internal, terutama mendekati ekstensi
butir.en: Secondary restraint to internal rotation, especially near extension
butir.zh: 内旋的次级限制结构，尤其在接近伸直位时
butir.uz: Ichki rotatsiyaning ikkilamchi cheklovchisi, ayniqsa yozilishga yaqin holatda

butir.id: Bundel AM makin tegang saat fleksi; bundel PL saat ekstensi
butir.en: The AM bundle tightens in flexion; the PL bundle in extension
butir.zh: AM束在屈曲时张力增加；PL束在伸直时张力增加
butir.uz: AM tutam bukilishda, PL tutam yozilishda tarang boʻladi

butir.id: Ruptur ACL disertai kelemahan quadriceps dan turunnya sensasi posisi sendi
butir.en: ACL rupture is accompanied by quadriceps weakness and reduced joint position sense
butir.zh: ACL断裂伴有股四头肌无力和关节位置觉下降
butir.uz: ACL yorilishi kvadritseps zaifligi va boʻgʻim holatini sezishning pasayishi bilan kechadi

judul.zh: 半月板：减震与负荷传导

butir.id: Menyalurkan 40–60% beban saat ekstensi, hingga 90% saat fleksi
butir.en: Transmits 40–60% of load in extension and up to 90% in flexion
butir.zh: 伸直时传导40–60%的负荷，屈曲时可达90%
butir.uz: Yozilishda yukning 40–60% ini, bukilishda 90% gachasini oʻtkazadi

butir.id: Hoop stress: serat sirkumferensial mengubah beban tekan menjadi tegangan melingkar
butir.en: Hoop stress: circumferential fibres convert compressive load into circumferential tension
butir.zh: 环向应力（hoop stress）：环形纤维将压缩负荷转化为环向张力
butir.uz: Hoop stress: aylana tolalar bosim yukini aylana taranglikka aylantiradi

butir.id: Root tear medial menaikkan tekanan puncak 25%, setara meniskektomi total; repair mengembalikannya
butir.en: A medial root tear raises peak pressure by 25%, equivalent to total meniscectomy; repair restores it
butir.zh: 内侧根部撕裂使峰值压力升高25%，相当于全半月板切除；修复可使其恢复
butir.uz: Medial ildiz yirtigʻi choʻqqi bosimni 25% ga oshiradi, bu toʻliq meniskektomiyaga teng; tikish uni tiklaydi

butir.id: Kornu posterior medial: penahan sekunder translasi anterior pada lutut tanpa ACL
butir.en: Medial posterior horn: secondary restraint to anterior translation in the ACL-deficient knee
butir.zh: 内侧半月板后角：ACL缺失膝中胫骨前移的次级限制结构
butir.uz: Medial orqa shox: ACL boʻlmagan tizzada oldinga siljishning ikkilamchi cheklovchisi

judul.id: Open kinetic chain dimulai di rentang 90–45° dari minggu ke-4 untuk membatasi beban pada graft
judul.en: Open kinetic chain starts in the 90–45° range from week 4 to limit load on the graft
judul.zh: 开链运动从第4周起在90–45°范围内开始，以限制移植物负荷
judul.uz: Graftga yukni cheklash uchun ochiq kinetik zanjir 4-haftadan 90–45° oraligʻida boshlanadi

judul.id: Beban meniskus naik saat fleksi: hindari fleksi dalam berbeban setelah repair
judul.en: Meniscal load rises with flexion: avoid deep loaded flexion after repair
judul.zh: 半月板负荷随屈曲增加：修复后避免负重深屈
judul.uz: Menisk yuki bukilishda ortadi: tikishdan keyin yuk bilan chuqur bukishdan saqlaning

judul.id: Robekan radial/root memutus hoop stress, sehingga butuh proteksi lebih lama
judul.en: Radial/root tears disrupt hoop stress, so they need longer protection
judul.zh: 放射状/根部撕裂破坏环向应力，因此需要更长时间的保护
judul.uz: Radial/ildiz yirtiqlari hoop stressni uzadi, shuning uchun uzoqroq himoya talab qilinadi

keterangan.id: Skema graft di posisi ACL: terowongan femur dan tibia dengan fiksasi femur dan tibia. Teknik dan jenis fiksasi bervariasi menurut operator.
keterangan.en: Schematic of the graft in the ACL position: femoral and tibial tunnels with femoral and tibial fixation. Technique and fixation type vary by surgeon.
keterangan.zh: 移植物位于ACL位置的示意图：股骨隧道与胫骨隧道，以及股骨端与胫骨端固定。技术与固定方式因术者而异。
keterangan.uz: ACL oʻrnidagi graft sxemasi: femur va tibia kanallari, femur va tibia fiksatsiyasi. Texnika va fiksatsiya turi operatorga qarab farq qiladi.

teks.id: Menilai dan menangani cedera penyerta (meniskus, kartilago)
teks.en: Assess and treat associated injuries (meniscus, cartilage)
teks.zh: 评估并处理合并损伤（半月板、软骨）
teks.uz: Hamroh jarohatlarni (menisk, togʻay) baholash va davolash

teks.id: Autograft tendon patela (BPTB), hamstring, atau tendon quadriceps
teks.en: Patellar tendon (BPTB), hamstring or quadriceps tendon autograft
teks.zh: 自体髌腱（BPTB）、腘绳肌腱或股四头肌腱移植物
teks.uz: Tizza qopqogʻi payi (BPTB), hamstring yoki kvadritseps payi autografti

teks.id: Terowongan femur dan tibia pada jejak (footprint) anatomis ACL
teks.en: Femoral and tibial tunnels at the anatomical ACL footprint
teks.zh: 在ACL解剖止点（footprint）处制备股骨与胫骨隧道
teks.uz: ACL anatomik izida (footprint) femur va tibia kanallari

teks.id: Graft ditarik melalui terowongan lalu difiksasi (sekrup interferensi atau suspensory button)
teks.en: The graft is pulled through the tunnels and fixed (interference screw or suspensory button)
teks.zh: 将移植物穿过隧道并固定（挤压螺钉或悬吊纽扣）
teks.uz: Graft kanallar orqali tortiladi va mahkamlanadi (interferension vint yoki suspensory button)

teks.id: Memastikan ekstensi penuh dan lutut stabil sebelum luka ditutup
teks.en: Confirm full extension and a stable knee before wound closure
teks.zh: 关闭切口前确认膝关节可完全伸直且稳定
teks.uz: Jarohat yopilishidan oldin toʻliq yozilish va tizza barqarorligini tasdiqlash

judul.id: Pilihan Graft dan Implikasinya bagi Rehabilitasi
judul.en: Graft Choice and Its Implications for Rehabilitation
judul.zh: 移植物选择及其对康复的影响
judul.uz: Graft tanlovi va uning reabilitatsiyaga taʼsiri

teks.id:
**Catatan:** Fiksasi tulang-ke-tulang. Nyeri di lokasi donor dan nyeri saat berlutut lebih sering dibanding tendon quadriceps.
**Implikasi rehab:** Pantau nyeri lutut depan; progresi beban patelofemoral bertahap.
teks.en:
**Note:** Bone-to-bone fixation. Donor-site pain and kneeling pain are more common than with the quadriceps tendon.
**Rehab implication:** Monitor anterior knee pain; progress patellofemoral loading gradually.
teks.zh:
**说明：**骨-骨固定。供区疼痛和跪地痛比股四头肌腱更常见。
**康复启示：**监测膝前痛；髌股关节负荷逐步递增。
teks.uz:
**Izoh:** Suyak-suyak fiksatsiyasi. Donor joydagi ogʻriq va tiz choʻkkanda ogʻriq kvadritseps payiga qaraganda koʻproq uchraydi.
**Reabilitatsiya uchun ahamiyati:** Tizza old qismidagi ogʻriqni kuzating; patellofemoral yukni bosqichma-bosqich oshiring.

teks.id:
**Catatan:** Semitendinosus ± gracilis, sayatan kecil. Laksitas dan kegagalan graft setara dengan tendon quadriceps.
**Implikasi rehab:** Lokasi donor di fleksor lutut: progresi penguatan hamstring bertahap, pantau nyeri.
teks.en:
**Note:** Semitendinosus ± gracilis, small incision. Laxity and graft failure are comparable to the quadriceps tendon.
**Rehab implication:** Donor site is in the knee flexors: progress hamstring strengthening gradually and monitor pain.
teks.zh:
**说明：**半腱肌 ± 股薄肌，切口小。松弛度和移植物失败率与股四头肌腱相当。
**康复启示：**供区位于屈膝肌群：腘绳肌力量训练逐步递增，监测疼痛。
teks.uz:
**Izoh:** Semitendinosus ± gracilis, kichik kesma. Boʻshashish va graft muvaffaqiyatsizligi kvadritseps payi bilan teng.
**Reabilitatsiya uchun ahamiyati:** Donor joy tizza bukuvchi mushaklarida: hamstringni kuchaytirishni bosqichma-bosqich oshiring, ogʻriqni kuzating.

teks.id:
**Catatan:** Nyeri lokasi donor lebih rendah dari BPTB (RR 0,25). Kegagalan graft setara (gabungan 2,1%).
**Implikasi rehab:** Prioritaskan aktivasi dan kekuatan quadriceps sejak awal.
teks.en:
**Note:** Lower donor-site pain than BPTB (RR 0.25). Comparable graft failure (pooled 2.1%).
**Rehab implication:** Prioritise quadriceps activation and strength from the outset.
teks.zh:
**说明：**供区疼痛低于BPTB（RR 0.25）。移植物失败率相当（合并2.1%）。
**康复启示：**从早期即优先进行股四头肌激活与力量训练。
teks.uz:
**Izoh:** Donor joy ogʻrigʻi BPTB dan past (RR 0,25). Graft muvaffaqiyatsizligi teng (umumiy 2,1%).
**Reabilitatsiya uchun ahamiyati:** Boshidanoq kvadritseps faollashuvi va kuchiga ustuvorlik bering.

label.zh: LET增强（外侧关节外肌腱固定术）

teks.id: Pada pasien muda risiko tinggi (usia 14–25, olahraga pivot, pivot shift ≥ derajat 2 atau hiperlaksitas), menambahkan LET pada graft hamstring menurunkan ruptur graft dari 11% menjadi 4% dalam 2 tahun (RCT STABILITY, n = 618).
teks.en: In young high-risk patients (aged 14–25, pivoting sports, pivot shift ≥ grade 2 or generalised hyperlaxity), adding LET to a hamstring graft reduced graft rupture from 11% to 4% at 2 years (STABILITY RCT, n = 618).
teks.zh: 在年轻高危患者（14–25岁、从事轴移类运动、pivot shift ≥ 2级或关节过度松弛）中，在腘绳肌腱移植物基础上加做LET，可使2年移植物断裂率从11%降至4%（STABILITY RCT，n = 618）。
teks.uz: Yosh yuqori xavfli bemorlarda (14–25 yosh, burilishli sport turlari, pivot shift ≥ 2-daraja yoki giperboʻshashish) hamstring graftiga LET qoʻshish 2 yil ichida graft yorilishini 11% dan 4% gacha kamaytirgan (STABILITY RCT, n = 618).

teks.en: References: [22] Mouarbes dkk., Am J Sports Med 2019 · [23] Getgood dkk., Am J Sports Med 2020
teks.zh: 参考文献：[22] Mouarbes dkk., Am J Sports Med 2019 · [23] Getgood dkk., Am J Sports Med 2020

teks.id: Sejajar serat; kandidat repair, terutama di zona merah
teks.en: Parallel to the fibres; a candidate for repair, especially in the red zone
teks.zh: 与纤维平行；适合修复，尤其位于红区时
teks.uz: Tolalarga parallel; tikish uchun nomzod, ayniqsa qizil zonada

teks.id: Memotong serat sirkumferensial; hoop stress hilang
teks.en: Cuts across the circumferential fibres; hoop stress is lost
teks.zh: 切断环形纤维；环向应力丧失
teks.uz: Aylana tolalarni kesib oʻtadi; hoop stress yoʻqoladi

teks.id: Membelah meniskus menjadi lapisan atas dan bawah
teks.en: Splits the meniscus into upper and lower layers
teks.zh: 将半月板分为上下两层
teks.uz: Meniskni yuqori va pastki qavatlarga ajratadi

teks.id: Lepas dari perlekatan tulang; fungsi ≈ meniskektomi total
teks.en: Detached from its bony attachment; function ≈ total meniscectomy
teks.zh: 自骨性附着处撕脱；功能≈全半月板切除
teks.uz: Suyakka birikkan joyidan ajraladi; funksiyasi ≈ toʻliq meniskektomiya

teks.id: **Pertahankan meniskus sebagai pilihan pertama.** Hasil jangka panjang meniskektomi parsial lebih buruk dibanding repair. Bila repair diindikasikan, operasi sesegera mungkin.
teks.en: **Preserve the meniscus as the first choice.** Long-term outcomes of partial meniscectomy are worse than those of repair. When repair is indicated, operate as soon as possible.
teks.zh: **保留半月板为首选。**半月板部分切除的远期疗效差于修复。若有修复指征，应尽早手术。
teks.uz: **Meniskni saqlash — birinchi tanlov.** Qisman meniskektomiyaning uzoq muddatli natijalari tikishdan yomonroq. Tikishga koʻrsatma boʻlsa, imkon qadar tezroq operatsiya qiling.

teks.id: Membuang bagian yang rusak saja. Rehab cepat tanpa proteksi khusus, tetapi fungsi penyalur beban berkurang.
teks.en: Removes only the damaged portion. Fast rehab without special protection, but load-distributing function is reduced.
teks.zh: 仅切除损伤部分。康复快、无需特殊保护，但负荷传导功能下降。
teks.uz: Faqat shikastlangan qism olib tashlanadi. Reabilitatsiya maxsus himoyasiz tez, ammo yuk taqsimlash funksiyasi kamayadi.

teks.id: Teknik all-inside, inside-out, atau outside-in. Butuh proteksi beban dan fleksi di fase awal.
teks.en: All-inside, inside-out or outside-in technique. Requires protection of weight-bearing and flexion in the early phase.
teks.zh: 全内、由内向外或由外向内技术。早期需限制负重与屈曲。
teks.uz: All-inside, inside-out yoki outside-in texnikasi. Dastlabki bosqichda yuk va bukilishdan himoya talab qilinadi.

teks.id: Umumnya transtibial pull-out. Mengembalikan tekanan kontak mendekati normal; proteksi paling ketat.
teks.en: Usually transtibial pull-out. Restores contact pressure close to normal; the strictest protection.
teks.zh: 通常采用经胫骨拉出（transtibial pull-out）技术。可使接触压力接近正常；保护要求最严格。
teks.uz: Odatda transtibial pull-out. Kontakt bosimini meʼyorga yaqin tiklaydi; eng qatʼiy himoya.

judul.en: The Type of Procedure Determines Early Restrictions

baris.id: Ekstensi penuh segera; fleksi sesuai toleransi
baris.en: Full extension immediately; flexion as tolerated
baris.zh: 立即完全伸直；屈曲按耐受
baris.uz: Darhol toʻliq yozish; bukish chidamlilikka qarab

baris.zh: **稳定型半月板修复**（纵行、ramp损伤）
对抗性运动4–6个月（单纯修复）

baris.en: Avoid for ≥ 4 months; strengthening from 4–5 months
baris.zh: 避免≥ 4个月；4–5个月开始力量训练

baris.en: About 9 months for professional pivoting sport
baris.zh: 职业轴移类运动约9个月
baris.uz: Professional burilishli sport uchun taxminan 9 oy

teks.id: Batasan di atas adalah acuan umum. Instruksi dokter operator tetap menjadi patokan utama, karena teknik fiksasi, lokasi dan stabilitas robekan berbeda pada tiap pasien.
teks.en: The restrictions above are general guidance. The operating surgeon's instructions remain the primary reference, because fixation technique, tear location and stability differ in each patient.
teks.zh: 以上限制为一般参考。手术医师的医嘱仍是首要依据，因为每位患者的固定技术、撕裂部位及稳定性各不相同。
teks.uz: Yuqoridagi cheklovlar umumiy yoʻriqnomadir. Asosiy mezon — operatsiya qilgan shifokor koʻrsatmalari, chunki fiksatsiya texnikasi, yirtiq joyi va barqarorligi har bir bemorda turlicha.

judul.id: Jenis Brace Lutut dan Kapan Dipakai
judul.en: Types of Knee Brace and When to Use Them
judul.zh: 膝关节支具类型及使用时机
judul.uz: Tizza ortezlari turlari va ularni qachon qoʻllash

pesan.en: Brace by indication, not by habit
pesan.zh: 支具按指征使用，而非出于习惯
pesan.uz: Ortez odat boʻyicha emas, koʻrsatma boʻyicha

teks.id:
Brace lurus, terkunci di ekstensi

**Kapan:** Hari-hari awal pasca-operasi untuk berjalan, bila quadriceps belum terkontrol (extension lag)
**Lepas:** Setelah SLR tanpa lag dan pola jalan aman
Praktik klinis umum; ikuti instruksi operator
teks.en:
Straight brace, locked in extension

**When:** First post-operative days for walking, when the quadriceps is not yet controlled (extension lag)
**Remove:** Once SLR is achieved without lag and gait is safe
Common clinical practice; follow the surgeon's instructions
teks.zh:
直型支具，锁定于伸直位

**使用时机：**术后最初几天用于行走，适用于股四头肌尚未能控制时（伸膝迟滞，extension lag）
**停用：**可完成无迟滞直腿抬高（SLR）且步态安全后
常规临床做法；遵从手术医师医嘱
teks.uz:
Toʻgʻri ortez, yozilgan holatda qulflangan

**Qachon:** Operatsiyadan keyingi dastlabki kunlarda yurish uchun, kvadritseps hali nazorat qilinmaganda (extension lag)
**Yechish:** SLR lagsiz bajarilganda va yurish xavfsiz boʻlganda
Umumiy klinik amaliyot; operator koʻrsatmalariga amal qiling

teks.id:
Brace berengsel dengan pengatur sudut (ROM brace)

**Kapan:** Repair meniskus: dibatasi 0–90° selama ± 6 minggu; cedera ligamen penyerta sesuai operator
**ACL saja:** Tidak rutin diperlukan; tidak terbukti bermanfaat dan menambah biaya
[13][14][28]
teks.en:
Hinged brace with adjustable angle (ROM brace)

**When:** Meniscal repair: limited to 0–90° for about 6 weeks; associated ligament injuries as per surgeon
**ACL only:** Not routinely needed; no proven benefit and adds cost
[13][14][28]
teks.zh:
带角度调节的铰链式支具（ROM支具）

**使用时机：**半月板修复：限制在0–90°约6周；合并韧带损伤遵医嘱
**单纯ACL：**无需常规使用；未证实有益且增加费用
[13][14][28]
teks.uz:
Burchak sozlagichli sharnirli ortez (ROM ortezi)

**Qachon:** Menisk tikilishi: taxminan 6 hafta 0–90° bilan cheklanadi; hamroh boylam jarohatlarida operatorga qarab
**Faqat ACL:** Muntazam kerak emas; foydasi isbotlanmagan va xarajatni oshiradi
[13][14][28]

teks.id:
Brace ACL / derotasi untuk aktivitas olahraga

**Kapan:** Opsional saat kembali berolahraga, terutama bila pasien merasa lebih percaya diri
**Bukti:** Belum terbukti menurunkan cedera ulang; bukan pengganti kriteria RTS
[29]
teks.en:
ACL / derotation brace for sporting activity

**When:** Optional on return to sport, especially if the patient feels more confident
**Evidence:** Not proven to reduce re-injury; not a substitute for RTS criteria
[29]
teks.zh:
用于运动的ACL/抗旋支具

**使用时机：**重返运动时可选用，尤其当患者佩戴后更有信心时
**证据：**未证实可降低再损伤；不能替代RTS标准
[29]
teks.uz:
Sport faoliyati uchun ACL / derotatsion ortez

**Qachon:** Sportga qaytishda ixtiyoriy, ayniqsa bemor oʻzini ishonchliroq his qilsa
**Dalil:** Qayta jarohatni kamaytirishi isbotlanmagan; RTS mezonlari oʻrnini bosmaydi
[29]

judul.id: Timeline Pemulihan: Tujuh Fase, Tujuh Gerbang
judul.en: Recovery Timeline: Seven Phases, Seven Gates
judul.zh: 康复时间线：七个阶段，七道关卡
judul.uz: Tiklanish vaqt jadvali: yetti bosqich, yetti darvoza

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Lutut tenang, ekstensi penuh, quadriceps aktif
teks.en: **Gate:** Quiet knee, full extension, active quadriceps
teks.zh: **关卡：**膝关节无急性炎症、可完全伸直、股四头肌可激活
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Tizza tinch, toʻliq yozilish, kvadritseps faol

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Ekstensi penuh, SLR tanpa lag
teks.en: **Gate:** Full extension, SLR without lag
teks.zh: **关卡：**完全伸直，无迟滞直腿抬高（SLR）
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Toʻliq yozilish, lagsiz SLR

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Jalan normal tanpa kruk
teks.en: **Gate:** Normal gait without crutches
teks.zh: **关卡：**无拐杖正常行走
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Qoʻltiqtayoqsiz normal yurish

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Kontrol satu kaki, kekuatan meningkat
teks.en: **Gate:** Single-leg control, improving strength
teks.zh: **关卡：**单腿控制良好，力量提高
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Bir oyoqda nazorat, kuch ortgan

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Kriteria lari terpenuhi
teks.en: **Gate:** Running criteria met
teks.zh: **关卡：**满足跑步标准
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Yugurish mezonlari bajarilgan

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Agility & latihan lapangan
teks.en: **Gate:** Agility & on-field training
teks.zh: **关卡：**敏捷性与场上训练
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Chaqqonlik va maydon mashgʻulotlari

teks.id: **Gerbang:** Seluruh kriteria RTS
teks.en: **Gate:** All RTS criteria
teks.zh: **关卡：**满足全部RTS标准
teks.uz: **Darvoza:** Barcha RTS mezonlari

judul.en: Modifications when a meniscal repair is present
judul.zh: 合并半月板修复时的调整

butir.id: Hindari fleksi berbeban dalam hingga ± 4 bulan
butir.en: Avoid deep loaded flexion until about 4 months
butir.zh: 约4个月内避免负重深屈
butir.uz: Taxminan 4 oygacha yuk bilan chuqur bukishdan saqlaning

butir.id: Radial/root: kembali ke olahraga pivot ± 9 bulan
butir.en: Radial/root: return to pivoting sport at about 9 months
butir.zh: 放射状/根部撕裂：约9个月重返轴移类运动
butir.uz: Radial/ildiz: burilishli sportga taxminan 9 oyda qaytish

teks.id:
Rentang waktu adalah perkiraan; naik fase hanya bila kriteria gerbang terpenuhi.
Referensi: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [2] van Melick 2016 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.en:
Time ranges are estimates; progress to the next phase only when the gate criteria are met.
References: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [2] van Melick 2016 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.zh:
时间范围仅为估计；只有满足关卡标准才能进入下一阶段。
参考文献：[1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [2] van Melick 2016 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [14] Calanna 2022
teks.uz:
Vaqt oraliqlari taxminiy; keyingi bosqichga faqat darvoza mezonlari bajarilganda oʻtiladi.
Manbalar: [1] Kotsifaki 2023 · [2] van Melick 2016 · [3] Grindem 2016 · [14] Calanna 2022

judul.id: Kembali Bekerja Jauh Sebelum Pulih Total
judul.en: Returning to Work Well Before Full Recovery
judul.zh: 远在完全康复之前即可重返工作
judul.uz: Toʻliq tiklanishdan ancha oldin ishga qaytish

kepala.en: Estimated time to return to work/activity
kepala.zh: 预计重返工作/活动时间

baris.en: From 2–4 weeks, with graded working hours

baris.zh: **完全恢复正常日常活动**（第3–4期）

label.id: pasien pasca-rekonstruksi ACL sudah kembali bekerja dalam 90 hari
label.en: of patients after ACL reconstruction had returned to work within 90 days
label.zh: ACL重建术后患者在90天内已重返工作的比例
label.uz: ACL rekonstruksiyasidan keyingi bemorlar 90 kun ichida ishga qaytgan

teks.id: Tinjauan sistematis, n = 1.791
teks.en: Systematic review, n = 1,791
teks.zh: 系统综述，n = 1791
teks.uz: Tizimli sharh, n = 1791

teks.id: Angka 9–12 bulan adalah untuk kembali bertanding. Pasien non-atlet tidak perlu menunggu selama itu untuk bekerja.
teks.en: The 9–12-month figure is for return to competition. Non-athlete patients do not need to wait that long to return to work.
teks.zh: 9–12个月指的是重返赛场的时间。非运动员患者无需等待这么久才重返工作。
teks.uz: 9–12 oy — bu musobaqaga qaytish muddati. Sportchi boʻlmagan bemorlar ishga qaytish uchun shuncha kutishlari shart emas.
